svg.title: LastDB and LastStore storage boundary
svg.desc: LastDB owns schemas, molecules, proteins, current tips, memory, and cloud meaning. LastStore owns batches of keys and bytes, read views, file pages, physical deletes, and compaction. Tips contain stable atom references, never file positions. Existing code supplies part of the target contract.
svg.text: LastDB decides what. LastStore manages disk bytes.
One process is enough. The contract separates responsibilities.
LastDB
Schemas · fields · molecules · proteins
Current tips · write order · shared atoms
Memory ack · warm set · 500 ms flush
Cloud work · permission to delete an atom
Owns the meaning of every stored record.
LastStore
Exact keys + exact bytes · complete batches
File pages · positions · free-space reuse
Captured read views · recovery · export holds
Physical deletes · compaction · resource limits
Owns file movement. Tips keep the same references.
The boundary
Batch keys and bytes · one read view · a durable receipt · explicit limits
Two molecule keys can share one stored atom
Tip for the key by ID
Tip for the key by email
Stable atom reference → stored bytes
Small atom bytes sit beside their key.
Larger atoms use more pages inside LastStore.
A tip has no physical position. Compaction does not change its atom reference.
Implementation state
Source exists: batch reads, ranges, native read views, maintenance, and recovery parts.
Selected: original native engine. Local completion and measurements use generated data.
Native LastStore engine selected · 16 October 2026 · Current values only · Primary unchanged
